guide.summary: Table Mountain's cableway, museums, galleries and food markets, with breakfast cafés, bakeries, dinners and cocktail bars checked against their own websites.
guide.tip: The Table Mountain Aerial Cableway says it may close in bad weather, so check its live status on the day; standard tickets stay valid for 7 days if the mountain is clouded in.

toolkit.label: Closing days
toolkit.value: Mon–Tue at Norval; Mon at Bo-Kaap Kombuis; Sun at the Science Centre
toolkit.copy: Norval Foundation is closed Monday and Tuesday, Bo-Kaap Kombuis is closed on Mondays, and the Cape Town Science Centre is closed on Sundays. The Iziko museums and Castle of Good Hope close on Christmas Day and Workers' Day.

toolkit.label: Tickets and booking
toolkit.value: Book ahead for District Six and fine dining
toolkit.copy: District Six Museum says bookings are essential via Quicket, and Bo-Kaap Kombuis says bookings are essential. FYN, La Colombe and The Pot Luck Club take deposits, with FYN and La Colombe refunding cancellations made more than 48 hours ahead.

toolkit.label: Walk-ins and queues
toolkit.copy: Standard Table Mountain Aerial Cableway tickets are valid for 7 days, while Fast Track needs an online timeslot. The Gin Bar welcomes walk-ins, entered through the Honest Chocolate cafe on Wale Street.

toolkit.label: Age rules
toolkit.copy: Zeitz MOCAA admits visitors under 18 free. La Colombe does not admit children under eight, and Bukhara (Church Street) does not allow under-12s at dinner service.

guide.dek: Pair the cableway with a weather-proof museum backup, and book dinners and District Six Museum ahead.
intro: Start with the Table Mountain Aerial Cableway on Tafelberg Road, where first cars go up at 08:30 and the operator warns the Cableway may close in bad weather. Standard tickets are valid for 7 days, which gives you room if cloud sets in, while Fast Track tickets need an online timeslot. On a closed-mountain day, the Two Oceans Aquarium on Dock Road at the V&A Waterfront is open daily from 9:30am to 6pm, and the Cape Town Science Centre in Observatory runs Monday to Saturday.

For art, Zeitz MOCAA in the Silo District opens daily from 10:00 to 18:00 with last entry at 17:30, and visitors under 18 enter free. Its current programme includes 'A Protea Is Not a Flower', running until 20 June 2027, with 'Were It Not for Shadows …' opening on 12 November 2026. Out in Tokai, the Norval Foundation is closed Monday and Tuesday; its Irma Stern exhibition 'Looking Closer to Home' runs until 10 January 2027.

History sits close together in the city centre. The Castle of Good Hope opens daily from 09h00 to 16h00, with last tickets at 15:45. The District Six Museum on Buitenkant Street opens Monday to Saturday and says bookings are essential. Iziko runs the South African Museum on Queen Victoria Street, the National Gallery on Government Avenue, the Slave Lodge and the Bo-Kaap Museum on Wale Street, all closed on Christmas Day and Workers' Day. You can then walk on to Bo-Kaap Kombuis on August Street, which is closed on Mondays and asks you to book.

For mornings, Hemelhuijs on Waterkant Street opens at 9am on weekdays, and Schoon in Sea Point opens at 07:00. The Oranjezicht City Farm Market moved to its new Granger Bay Boulevard site in December 2025 and trades on Saturday and Sunday mornings, plus a Wednesday night market outside June and July. In the evening, FYN serves dinner Monday to Saturday, The Pot Luck Club takes a deposit per guest, and The Gin Bar on Wale Street welcomes walk-ins from 3pm Thursday to Saturday.
summaryCards: Ride the Table Mountain Aerial Cableway early, then spend the afternoon at the Castle of Good Hope and the District Six Museum.
Have breakfast at Hemelhuijs or Schoon (Sea Point), then browse the Oranjezicht City Farm Market on a Saturday or Sunday.
Check the cableway's weather status on the day, avoid Norval Foundation on Mondays and Tuesdays, and expect deposits at FYN, La Colombe and The Pot Luck Club.

limitations: Website review, not a visit or telephone confirmation. Advertised opening, booking and exhibition details do not guarantee availability. SANParks pages (Cape of Good Hope, Boulders) returned 403 and the V&A Waterfront site and several coffee roasters (Truth, Bootlegger, Espresso Lab, Origin, Rosetta, Tribe, Deluxe) returned 429, so they are not included; Cape Point gives no exact address and says its funicular closes for maintenance from 26 October 2026. Kirstenbosch and Groot Constantia did not publish a street address on the pages read. Iziko pages give inconsistent winter hours and no exhibition run dates; Iziko, District Six Museum, Hemelhuijs and Knead (Muizenberg) showed no 2026-dated content; La Colombe and Harbour House (Kalk Bay) publish no street number; Neighbourgoods Market and Planet Bar publish no hours. Coffee entries are cafés and bakeries rather than specialist roasters because roaster sites could not be read.
